extracted.name: Goat Cheese and Arugula over Penne
extracted.description: Combine goat cheese with arugula, cherry tomatoes, olive oil, and garlic; toss with hot penne pasta for an absolutely delicious, yet simple summertime dish.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups coarsely chopped arugula, stems included
instruction_lines: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente.
Crumble goat cheese into a large serving bowl. Add arugula, cherry tomatoes, olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Drain pasta; toss with goat cheese mixture until well combined.
